Status: Version 2 keeps every row and template of version 1 and adds the sales of S4 (spec 14 section 4.3, spec 13 section 5.5): the three sales roles SLP (preparer), SLR (reviewer) and SLA (approver), custom roles that the tenant may rename or change; the request types PROFORMA_REQUEST, SALES_ORDER_APPROVAL and COLLECTION_DOCS_REQUEST with their audiences (SLP, TM, FO, TE); and their three templates: the proforma's chain preparation, review, approval, treasury queue and issue (lc.validate_terms on SUBMIT and RESUBMIT, lc.issue_proforma on COMPLETE of ISSUE_PROFORMA); the sales order's manager approval, treasury queue and earmark (lc.earmark_sales_order); and the collection documents' manager approval, treasury queue, preparation and hand-over (lc.convert_earmark, the COLLECTION_DOCS_PACKAGE attachment required before DOCS_ISSUED). A template already seeded under its SeedKey at an earlier version is kept, so the five templates of version 1 are not published again. A proposed default written by an AI agent.
Sources: docs/30-readiness/DOC-F10 and DOC-F11 (template proposals DQ-F10-1 to 13, hooks DQ-F11-1 to 9)
Templates: templates/*.json: one graph per file (BankFas.Core.Workflow.TemplateGraph), stages and roles named by key and code.

NotSeeded.req.assign_number: The request number is allocated by the engine on entering the template's NumberOnStageKey (BR-WFL-013), so no hook row carries it.
